entities.summary: Wuhan Museum is a museum in Wuhan, Hubei, China. Construction began in 1984 and it was opened in 1986. In 2001, a new building was completed and opened to the public. It has a total built-up area of 17,834 square metres (191,960 sq ft). The display area is up to 6,000 square metres (65,000 sq ft). The museum was named in May 2008 as a national first-grade museum of China. In January 2009, Wuhan municipal cultural relic store was merged into Wuhan Museum.
